Question:

On AoG: Spite's new oversized villain card, AoG side, it now says "...If there are more cards under the safe house then drugs face-up, flip a face-down villain card face-up," instead of "flip a drug face-down." Is this change intentional or accidental?

If intentional, doesn't this make saving Victims/flipping his character card even more of a pointless task than before (in most circumstances)?
